name: CIS Microsoft Azure Database Services Benchmark
note: Each test implements the audit procedure of the recommendation it is mapped to. Recommendations that CIS marks Manual list a test where Azure Resource Manager shows the setting. Sections 7, 8 and 10 to 14 hold no recommendations.

2.2.title: Ensure that 'Allow access only via SSL' is set to 'Yes'

2.3.title: Ensure that 'Minimum TLS version' is set to TLS v1.2 (or higher)

2.4.title: Ensure that 'Access Policies' are Implemented and Reviewed Periodically

2.5.title: Ensure that 'System Assigned Managed Identity' is set to 'On'

2.7.title: Ensure Azure Cache for Redis is Using a Private Link

2.8.title: Ensure that Azure Cache for Redis is Using CustomerManaged Keys

2.9.title: Ensure 'Access Keys Authentication' is set to 'Disabled'

3.1.title: Ensure That 'Firewalls & Networks' Is Limited to Use Selected Networks Instead of All Networks

3.2.title: Ensure that Cosmos DB uses Private Endpoints where possible

3.5.title: Ensure critical data is encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK)

3.6.title: Ensure the firewall does not allow all network traffic

3.7.title: Ensure that Cosmos DB Logging is Enabled

4.1.title: Ensure Data Factory is encrypted using Customer Managed Keys

4.2.title: Ensure Data Factory is using Managed Identities

4.3.title: Ensure that Data Factory is using Azure Key Vault to store Credentials and Secrets

4.4.title: Ensure that Data Factory is using RBAC to manage privilege assignment

5.1.title: Ensure Azure Database for MySQL uses Customer Managed Keys for Encryption at Rest

5.2.title: Ensure Azure Database for MySQL uses only Microsoft Entra Authentication

5.3.title: Ensure `Public Network Access` is `Disabled` for Azure Database for MySQL

5.4.title: Ensure Private Endpoints Are Used for Azure MySQL Databases

5.5.title: Ensure server parameter 'audit_log_enabled' is set to 'ON' for MySQL flexible server

5.6.title: Ensure server parameter 'audit_log_events' has 'CONNECTION' set for MySQL flexible server

5.7.title: Ensure server parameter 'error_server_log_file' is Enabled for MySQL Database Server

5.8.title: Ensure server parameter 'require_secure_transport' is set to 'ON' for MySQL Server

5.9.title: Ensure server parameter 'tls_version' is set to 'TLSv1.2' (or higher) for MySQL flexible server

6.1.title: Ensure Azure Database for PostgreSQL uses Customer Managed Keys for Encryption at Rest

6.2.title: Ensure Azure Database for PostgreSQL uses only Microsoft Entra Authentication

6.3.title: Ensure `Public Network Access` is `Disabled` for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

6.4.title: Ensure Private Endpoints Are Used for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

6.5.title: Ensure server parameter 'connection_throttle.enable' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL server

6.6.title: Ensure server parameter 'logfiles.retention_days' is greater than 3 days for PostgreSQL server

6.7.title: Ensure server parameter 'log_checkpoints' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL server

6.8.title: Ensure server parameter 'log_disconnections' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL servers

6.9.title: Ensure server parameter 'log_connections' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL servers

6.10.title: Ensure server parameter 'require_secure_transport' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL server

6.11.title: Ensure server parameter 'ssl_min_protocol_version' is set to 'TLSv1.2' or higher for PostgreSQL server

9.2.title: Ensure that 'Public Network Access' is set to 'Disable'

9.3.title: Ensure no Azure SQL Database firewall rule is overly permissive

9.4.title: Ensure SQL server's Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) protector is encrypted with Customer-managed key

9.5.title: Ensure that Microsoft Entra authentication is Configured for SQL Servers

9.6.title: Ensure that 'Data encryption' is set to 'On' on a SQL Database

9.7.title: Ensure that 'Auditing' Retention is 'greater than 90 days'

9.8.title: Ensure 'Minimum TLS Version' is set to 'TLS 1.2' or higher
